header: Querying CloudWatch Logs data in OpenSearch Discover
content:
To query your data, select your data source from the drop-down menu. If you're using CloudWatch
Logs, navigate to Discover from your Essentials workspace and start querying data using
OpenSearch SQL or Piped Processing Language (PPL). For a list of supported commands, see the
section called “Supported SQL and PPL commands”.
Note
If you’ve created a materialized view, you can use DQL to query your data given that you’ve
indexed it within.
